about: What the engine (engine/redact.go) and the app (Logs.java) take out of a line before it is logged or an error leaves the engine. Both are checked against every case: in becomes out, and out stays out. A case whose out is the same as its in checks that nothing a person needs is lost.

cases.out: [network] couldn't list files: Get "https://www.premiumize.me/api/folder/list?***": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:9: connect: connection refused
